budget_chars.description: Token budget in characters (defaults to AUDREY_CONTEXT_BUDGET_CHARS or 4000).

cwd.description: Scope tool-failure risks to the project containing this directory.

include_risks.description: Include recent tool failures as risks (default true).

limit.description: Max recall results to consider before categorization.

mode.description: Capsule mode: conservative = fewer, higher-confidence entries; aggressive = broader sweep.

query.description: Natural-language query for the turn. Drives what gets surfaced.

scope.description: agent restricts memory recall to this MCP server agent identity. shared searches the whole store. Defaults to agent.
